evidence.explanation: C pool/lava calls are reproduced by local JS predicates in both level-placement consumers. Eight keys describe one shared predicate-delegation cause. The Juiblex exception applies to raised drawbridge moat substrate, not direct MOAT terrain.
evidence.proof: 128 raised-drawbridge comparisons:4 substrate masks (moat/lava/ice/floor) ×4 directions ×ordinary/Juiblex identity ×humidity0/WET/HOT/both. Exact C is_ok_location/occupied plus is_pool/is_moat/is_lava bodies match production JS exported consumers for eligibility and occupancy. Stored terrain/mask is unchanged. No trap, invocation position, custom predicate or water-level override is present.
evidence.control: 72 controls:9 direct/lowered terrains ×ordinary/Juiblex identity ×4 humidity masks. Direct POOL/MOAT/WATER stay wet on Juiblex, direct lava remains hot, and stone/room/ice/lowered bridge remain nonliquid. All fixed interior-cell results match. This does not prove bridge construction/operation, arbitrary placement, object/monster/runtime effects or whole topology.
